prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency for Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. To get started, tell me a few quick things:

- City or metro area (e.g., Baltimore, Annapolis, Silver Spring, Columbia)  
- Primary goals (brand building, lead gen, e-commerce growth, SEO, paid media, social, content, PR, etc.)  
- Industry (B2B tech, healthcare, professional services, retail, nonprofit, etc.)  
- Annual marketing budget range (or monthly)  
- Preference: local agency vs. remote/national partner; small boutique vs. larger/full-service

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use this checklist and process:

1. Narrow by specialty: pick agencies that focus on the service(s) you need (SEO, paid media, creative/branding, PR, performance marketing, etc.).  
2. Review evidence: look for case studies with measurable outcomes, relevant client experience, and references.  
3. Reputation sources: check Clutch, UpCity, Google/FB reviews, LinkedIn, and local industry awards (MarCom, Ad Age regional lists).  
4. Team & culture fit: ask who will do the work (not just the salesperson), see resumes/portfolios, and meet the proposed team.  
5. Measurement & reporting: confirm KPIs, reporting cadence, and access to dashboards.  
6. Contract terms & pricing: get clarity on fees, scope, minimum terms, and exit clauses.  
7. Trial project: start with a small, time-boxed pilot to validate capability before committing long-term.  
8. References and results: ask for references and verify results (URLs, campaign metrics, before/after data).

Questions to ask an agency in your first call:
- Which similar clients have you worked with, and what were the outcomes?  
- Who will be on my account and how much time will they allocate?  
- What tools/platforms do you use (analytics, CRM, ad platforms)?  
- How do you define success and report progress?  
- Can you show a recent case study with measurable results?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a short list of top Maryland agencies tailored to your needs, or  
- Search Clutch/UpCity and produce 5–7 recommended firms with pros/cons and next-step messaging templates.

Which would you prefer?
